purpose: A schematic of the rule and of the quantities it leaves open, for the paper on the two works. Text and arrows only, plus one tile of work 1 cut from an existing image; it shows no value that has not been shown before.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-28 and committed before any script for it exists and before anything is drawn. Seen before: everything of results/work1, results/work1_drawing, results/work2_words, results/sketch_sp_color and the conditions they were made on. Version 2 (2026-10-28, still before any script or drawing), after the cross review of the task (.steering/20261028-while-blind-judgement): eps acts on the images of work 2 and only on the supplementary image of work 1 (version 1 had it the other way); the placeholders begin with FILL so that load_conditions catches them; the values of work 2 are read from works/conditions/work2_sp_color.json instead of being chosen after the scoring; a row for the scale of V and A (map B or percentiles); every value is either a path to a key of a conditions file or a literal checked against one. Version 3 (2026-10-29, still before any script or drawing for the schematic, after the scoring of the blind judgement, results/blind_judgement/score.json of 363b5c0, was read): the drawing of work 2 is filled in as the grey with colour (SPC). The rule promised in work2_main (written before the scoring is read) was not written; the choice rests on the decision of the researcher made before the scoring (decision 2 of .steering/20261028-while-blind-judgement: the coloured version in the body of the paper), and is recorded as a decision made without the promised rule in .steering/20261028-outline-v25 (decision 1). Version 4 (2026-10-30, still before any script or drawing for the schematic, after the draft v0.1 of the paper; decision 4 of .steering/20261030-draft-fill-blanks): the label of eps reads 'smoothing parameter ε', the name of section 2 of the draft; the strings drawn spell gray and color; the box of the rule names the sharpness γ; a row for the warp of the field is added (work 1 names no warp and takes the default of the generator, none; work 2 reads field.warp of works/conditions/work2_words.json), since the caption of figure 1 in the draft names the warp among the quantities the maker sets; the scale of V and A of work 2 names its reference as section 2 and figure 8 do. Keys and notes keep their spelling. The checks of the literals of work 2 are written out (must_contain or equals), since version 3 named only a file and a key. Seen before version 4: everything of version 3, the draft v0.1 of the paper and figure 8 of version 20. Version 5 (2026-10-30, still before anything of the schematic is drawn by a committed script; a trial ran in a scratch worktree on version 4; decision 8 of .steering/20261030-draft-fill-blanks): the check of the drawing of work 2 also reads the direction of the hue (colour.hue.SPC.reads, 'at p_valence 0') and of the chroma (colour.status, 'saturation raises arousal'), since version 4 checked the words of the literal but not which of V and A drives hue and chroma (the review before the run). Seen before version 5: everything of version 4 and the trial image of version 4. Version 6 (2026-10-30, after round 1 of the critiques of the manuscript v0.2, before any change of the script and before anything of version 6 is drawn; decision 2 of .steering/20261030-manuscript-revise-r1, adopted by the researcher): the lexicon of work 2 is drawn as the literal 'MEmoLon, Japanese', checked against lexicon.name of works/conditions/work2.json, since version 5 drew the key as written, which holds the name of the file (MTL_grouped-ja.tsv), a word no reader of the figure needs (R2 and E of round 1); the note of eps of work 1, which is not drawn, also names the four drawings of figure 4, which use eps (Codex C2 of round 1: works/work1_drawing.py computes eps with relief.eps_for); the dash of work 1 stays, since it marks a quantity that does not act on the main images of work 1 (figures 2 and 3). Seen before version 6: everything of version 5, its output (results/rule_schematic), the manuscript v0.2 (outside the repository), round 1 of the critiques of the manuscript and its review by Codex. results/rule_schematic_v6 is the output. Amended on 2026-10-30, before any run of version 6 in the repository (a trial ran in a scratch worktree): the check of the lexicon of work 2 is equals on the whole value of lexicon.name, 'MEmoLon, Japanese (MTL_grouped-ja.tsv)', in place of must_contain 'MEmoLon, Japanese', so that any change of the lexicon or of its file stops the run (the review by Codex before the run; must_contain passed 'Not MEmoLon, Japanese').

layout.colour: black, white and greys only (the figure must read in print without colour)
layout.direction: left to right, one row of boxes joined by arrows

boxes.text: a unit of text (a sentence in work 1, a word in work 2)
valence V and arousal A from a lexicon, put on a scale
the rule: V and A give fineness f, depth s and sharpness γ
the field of the generator (a seed, four octaves)
the relief: height under a scale
the image of the relief (how it is drawn)

open_quantities.how: labels in a second row under the box they act on, written as 'name: work 1 value / work 2 value'; each value is given either as a path {file, key} read at drawing time or as a literal; a literal is checked against the key named in its 'check' (else the run stops); a dash means the quantity does not act on the main images of that work; from version 4 a literal may carry check_absent instead of check: the key named must be absent from the file and the default named must hold in the installed generator (else the run stops); from version 4 every check is explicit: must_contain (each string occurs in the text of the keys named) or equals (the value of the key equals it), and a literal with neither check nor check_absent is drawn as written (the literals of the height scale and of the drawing and units of work 1)
open_quantities.work2_main: the main images of work 2 are those of works/conditions/work2_sp_color.json (its versions SP and SPC); the scoring of the blind judgement decides only which of the grey and the coloured images is shown as the main one, by a rule written in the conditions of the paper's figures before the scoring is read. Until then work2.image_shown is FILL

work2.literal: percentiles among all uses of lexicon words in the 23 works, each author weighted equally, spread over [-1, 1]
one per word from its spelling

check_absent.default: atact.field: the default of warp is 0.0

work1.literal: common to the series (per-tile min-max shown next to it)

work1.note: work 1 uses eps in the supplementary image common_eps.png and in the four drawings of figure 4 (works/work1_drawing.py), not in its main images (figures 2 and 3)

work1.literal: gray; light from two directions; stretched

work2.literal: gray with color (OKLCH: lightness from the gray, chroma from arousal, hue from valence)

tile.what: the tile of the first sentence of work 1 under the common scale, cut from results/work1/common.png at its place in the layout of work 1 (no resampling), shown under the box 'image'
tile.check: the cut equals the tile drawn afresh by works/work1.py for sentence 1 byte for byte (else the run stops)

outputs: results/rule_schematic_v6/rule_schematic.png and rule_schematic.json (provenance: the conditions read and their SHA-256, every value read and every literal checked); results/rule_schematic (version 5) is kept
not_claimed: A schematic of the steps; it makes no claim about the effect of any quantity.
